clips.text: Want a pixel reel of your own? It takes one box, and one button. Here's how.
See My notes, right beside me? Type in it. Or press Speak, and just say it out loud.
Put in anything. Paste a link to a page. The transcript of a meeting. Or a question you have always wondered about.
Then press Make my next reel. Claude writes it, I read it out, and it plays in about a minute.
Every reel you make has My notes beside it too. Ask more, and your next reel carries on from there.
Not sure where to start? Try one of these. Why do cats knead blankets? Or, how does a plane stay up?
